t: The Daily Show: Mike D & Ad-Rock
d: Host Jon Stewart welcomes musicians Mike D and Ad-Rock to celebrate the 40th Anniversary of Beastie Boys album "Licensed to Ill."
Host Jon Stewart is joined by journalist and author Matthew Cole, author of "Princes and Thieves: Jared Kushner and Mohamed bin Zayed's Secret Plot to Remake the Middle East."
Host Jon Stewart sits down with author Michael Lewis to discuss the book "Blockers."
Host Jon Stewart is joined by Rachel Maddow, MS NOW host and author, discussing the book "Department of Fate."
